# Vendored from anthropics/skills (frontend-design)

Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design at commit `dbd4588f9e1033efb41dad4bef2f7947c8993d44` (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.txt).
`frontend-design.md` is `SKILL.md` copied verbatim and pinned; not fetched at runtime.

Reading notes for Itqan: "the client" is the Itqan user and "the brief" is the approved Product Spec plus the Constitution. Itqan applies this skill's art-direction process (design plan, review against generic defaults, build, screenshot critique) in the UX Spec, and its build and copy guidance in the Build stage. For app screens (Operate surfaces), `vendor/impeccable/operate.md` tempers it: familiarity and consistency come first, and the boldness is spent in one place.
